Firecrawl announced a $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital, with Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures participating. The announcement was made on September 22, 2026, alongside the launch of Alexandria, a platform that gives AI agents access to specialized datasets through one interface. No valuation was disclosed.

Sources disagree on some details:
- **Headquarters:** One source places the company in Los Angeles, while others say San Francisco.
- **Series A:** One source gives it as $20.7M, another as $14.5M.
- **Founding year:** Most sources say 2024, but a Dealroom company profile says 2022.
- **SEC filing:** RuntimeWire reported a Form D showing about $82.06M in preferred stock sold, which it said is roughly $7.1M more than the announced round. It noted neither disclosure explains the gap.

content.text:
Firecrawl raised a **$75 million Series B**. **Smash Capital** led the round. Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures also took part.

Alongside the round, Firecrawl announced **Alexandria**. It's a platform that gives AI agents access to specialized datasets through one interface, which the coverage describes as a data or knowledge library for agents. The announcement came on September 22, 2026. No valuation was disclosed.

Some sources name the lead as "Smash Ventures" instead of Smash Capital. One report also notes an SEC Form D showing about $82M in preferred stock sold, roughly $7M more than the announced amount, and says neither disclosure explains the gap.

Sources:
- [Web-Scraping Firm Firecrawl Raises $75M Series B Led by Smash Ventures](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/web-scraping-firm-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-led-by-smash-ventures-for-ai)
- [Dealroom: Firecrawl raises $75M Series B to build a knowledge library for AI agents](https://dealroom.co/news/155341-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-to-build-a-knowledge-library-for-ai-agents/)
